# Figures {.figure-page-title}

The 894 occupations of the paper, on the three axes recovered from O\*NET.
On every axis, **+ means harder to automate**. The coordinates are in
[`output/plot_data.csv`](output/plot_data.csv), one row per occupation.

## The occupation space in three dimensions {#space}

```{=html}
<figure class="plot-figure">
  <div class="plot plot-3d" id="plot-space" role="img"
       aria-label="Three-dimensional scatter plot of 894 occupations on the physical intensity, judgement and person-facing axes, coloured by union coverage."></div>
  <figcaption><b>Figure 6.1</b> — the three-axis space, coloured by union
  coverage. Drag to rotate; hold ⌘ or Ctrl and scroll to zoom. Marker size is
  log employment; hover for the occupation.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

## The pairwise sections {#sections}

```{=html}
<figure class="plot-figure">
  <div class="plot-controls">
    <label for="section-select">Section</label>
    <select id="section-select"></select>
  </div>
  <div class="plot plot-2d" id="plot-section" role="img"
       aria-label="Scatter plot of 894 occupations on two of the axes; the menu above chooses the pair."></div>
  <figcaption><b>Figure 6.3</b> — any two axes plotted against each other; the
  menu chooses the pair. Dotted lines mark the medians; marker size is log
  employment.</figcaption>
</figure>
```

:::
